The '''LSS Bind-1''' were a model of [[Stuncuffs/Legends|stun cuffs]] manufactured by [[Locris Syndicated Securities/Legends|Locris Syndicated Securities]] and sold for 25 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. They were available in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].
